name: inference
description: Provider-agnostic model resolution: one seam turns (role) into model + provider options, so you can swap where inference runs (Vercel AI Gateway, Mistral EU, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) without touching call sites. A fail-closed chooser keeps an unvetted or misconfigured target from ever serving traffic; residency/retention are operator-declared metadata enforced by the injected gateway options, not by the block.

env.name: INFERENCE_TARGET
env.desc: next-postgres adapter only: overrides the stored target id. The core reads no env.

env.name: <TARGET>_API_KEY
env.desc: the apiKeyEnv you name on each off-gateway target (e.g. MISTRAL_API_KEY, SCW_SECRET_KEY). Read via the injected secret reader, never by the core directly. A target with no key present is never selectable.

adapters.name: next-postgres
adapters.desc: Runtime target selection backed by a settings table + env override, with a short cache and the fail-closed downgrade. You pass readSetting/writeSetting for your DB client.
